_source: den Hengst et al., Conformal Intent Classification and Clarification for Fast and Accurate Intent Recognition, Findings NAACL 2024, https://aclanthology.org/2024.findings-naacl.156/. The paper has no zero-shot classifier prompt and the datasets ship no intent definitions; criteria are the released intent names (authors' labels.csv, repo commit 18019a1) rendered with the authors' own `replace('_', ' ')` (Appendix B tables), prefixed with the intent's domain from the official MTOD release (domain/intent). Assistant context from the dataset paper: Schuster et al. (2019), multilingual task-oriented dialog (English part): alarm, reminder and weather domains.

question.instructions: The state holds one utterance ("utterance") from a user of a task-oriented assistant for alarms, reminders and weather. Identify the user's intent: choose the single intent from the options that the utterance expresses.
